historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: 10-year base-path average (FY2026 -7% dip, +2-4% FY2027-29, Naga3 step-up FY2030-31, fade to 2.5% terminal). Not capped at the -9.9% FY2018-25 through-cycle revenue CAGR: that window starts one year before the FY2019 junket-era peak (1,755) and ends with FY2025 revenue (710) still 60% below it after the FY2020-21 COVID closure (226 in FY2021). A negative through-cycle CAGR would project perpetual revenue decline for a business whose Mass Market segment grew volume +6.2% in H1 FY2026; the base path instead assumes VIP never returns to 2019 levels and only Mass Market compounds.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (7.7%) diverges >30% from revenue 5yr (-4.2%) and EPS 5yr (23.9%); the 7yr revenue CAGR is -9.9%. All trailing windows are distorted by the FY2020-21 COVID collapse (revenue 1,755 -> 226) and the FY2024 US$89m Vladivostok impairment. The 4.0% selected rate exceeds the -9.9% through-cycle figure deliberately (see growth_rate_source): the -9.9% is a peak-to-post-trough artefact, not a trend, and the base path already takes FY2026 revenue down 7% and never assumes a return to junket-era VIP (FY2035 base revenue ~US$1.0bn is still below FY2019's 1,755).
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF less interest income; SBC nil): FY2018 230.1, FY2019 253.5, FY2020 50.4, FY2021 -114.8, FY2022 177.3, FY2023 231.8, FY2024 184.0, FY2025 299.7. Owner and reported FCF CAGRs are within 0.3pp because SBC is zero and interest income is 1-2% of FCF.

scenario_narratives.base: Mass Market keeps compounding on Phnom Penh's growing resident/expatriate base, the new Techo airport and Chinese visa facilitation, while VIP stays volatile and flat-to-down: FY2026 revenue falls ~7% then grows 2-4% a year. Management resizes Naga3 to roughly half the 2019 GMP scope (~US$1.3bn still to spend FY2027-30), funds it from cash flow without debt or equity, and opens it late 2029 for a two-year revenue step-up of ~18% at a temporarily diluted margin. The license exclusivity holds, the SDA tax exemption is respected, and the Prince Group sanctions fallout stays a sentiment rather than a regulatory event for NagaCorp. EBITDA margin 55-58%, terminal 56%; terminal value capped at 12x FCF (Gordon at 12.5%/2.5% is 10x, so Gordon binds).
scenario_narratives.bull: VIP recovers as Thailand-Cambodia tensions ease and Chinese business travel returns through the new airport; Mass Market win rates and premium-mass yield hold near H1 FY2026 levels, so margins sit at 59-60%. Naga3 is phased and downsized to ~US$0.8bn of remaining spend, funded comfortably from cash, and still lifts revenue ~21% over FY2030-31. The 30% dividend payout and net cash position earn a re-rating toward a regional-peer multiple; terminal 14x FCF, 3% growth. Does NOT assume a return to 2019 junket-era VIP volumes.
scenario_narratives.bear: The US$3.08bn GMP contract is honoured at full scale with no external funding: capex of ~US$700m a year FY2027-29 overwhelms ~US$300m of FCF, cash is exhausted and the company levers up for a project sized for 2019 junket demand that no longer exists. Meanwhile sanctions-driven AML scrutiny and recurring border clashes push VIP rollings down and keep Chinese arrivals subdued (revenue -10% FY2026, -3% FY2027, flat to FY2029), margins compress to 50-52%, and the MOEF chips away at the tax exemption via Obligation Payment reassessments (cash tax ramps to 10%). Naga3's eventual opening adds only ~14% to revenue against ~US$3bn invested. Terminal 10x FCF, 2% growth. This scenario values the equity at roughly today's price -- it is what the market is pricing.

valuation_philosophy.summary: NagaCorp is a legally protected monopoly casino in a frontier market generating ~US$300m of owner FCF on a US$1.25bn market cap with US$416m net cash -- about 2x EV/EBITDA. The cheapness is not a mispricing of the operating business; it is the market pricing the bear case on Naga3 capital allocation (the full US$3.08bn GMP commitment) together with Cambodia/sanctions country risk. The valuation therefore turns almost entirely on how much of the contracted Naga3 spend actually happens and at what return, which is why the scenarios differ mainly in the FY2027-30 capex path and the bear carries 35%. Cash flows are USD and the HKD quote is pegged, so FX is not a value driver. SBC is nil, so house and street bases coincide. Sanity check (2026-10-23): the multiples check tripped on 'base upside 168% with price in the upper half of the 10yr range'. The price-position and historical-multiple figures in that block are an fx artefact (the HKD price series was multiplied by fx_rate 7.84 instead of divided, so printed P/B ~128x, EV/EBITDA ~2250x and a 126% range position; the real position is the 10-year LOW, and real history is P/B 0.7-3.5x, EV/EBITDA 5-18x ex-COVID, P/S 2.8-8.7x ex-COVID). The one diagnosis candidate that is real -- regulatory single point of failure -- was applied as a +1.0pp WACC premium (11.5% -> 12.5%); the growth candidate (4.0% vs a -9.9% COVID-distorted through-cycle CAGR) was justified rather than capped. At the post-fix base IV the implied multiples sit inside the real historical range, so the thesis framing is unchanged: a net-cash monopoly casino at ~2x EV/EBITDA whose discount is the market pricing the Naga3 capital-allocation bear case.
key_risks_to_valuation: Naga3 proceeds at or near the full US$3.08bn contracted scope, self-funded with debt, with returns far below the cost of capital (the bear case, and roughly what the current price implies)
US/UK sanctions on Cambodia's Prince Group network broaden into AML enforcement, correspondent-banking or visa restrictions that hit NagaWorld's VIP and junket channels directly
Thailand-Cambodia border conflict or China outbound-travel policy depresses international arrivals for longer than the FY2026-27 dip assumed
MOEF reassesses gaming Obligation Payments or the SDA/SSDA tax exemption is eroded despite Casino Law Article 94 protection

Governance: founder-estate control (Sakai Trust) and related-party structures could divert cash flow from minorities (the Naga3 contractor relationship and the forfeited US$316m advance deserve continued scrutiny)
Upside risk: a formal Naga3 downsizing announcement or a special dividend from the cash pile would move the base toward the bull case quickly

sanity_check.fix_applied: 2026-10-23 one-pass fix after exit 3 (trip: 'Base case upside 168% with price in the upper half of the 10yr range (126%)'). (1) WACC +1.0pp regulatory single-point-of-failure premium, 11.5% -> 12.5% in all three scenarios (diagnosis candidate wacc_too_low; template low end). (2) growth_too_high NOT applied as a cap: the -9.9% FY2018-25 through-cycle CAGR is a pre-peak-to-post-COVID artefact; justification recorded in historical_growth. (3) No peak-earnings or exit-multiple fix: base already takes FY2026 revenue -7% off a 57% margin, and Gordon (10x at 12.5%/2.5%) binds below the 12x cap. Effect: base IV HK$5.95 -> 5.30, weighted HK$5.05 -> 4.51. NOTE on the trip itself: the price-position (126%) and historical-multiple figures in this block are an fx-direction artefact of scripts/sanity_check.py on a USD-reporting/HKD-quoted ticker (HKD price x fx_rate instead of / fx_rate: FY2018 printed price 75.47 = HK$9.63 x 7.8365; the current HKD price x 7.8365 compared against the raw, unconverted HKD 10-year series gives 1.2585). The real 10yr range position is 0% (the current price IS the 10-year low); real historical P/B 0.73-3.46x, EV/EBITDA 5.0-18.5x ex-FY2021, P/S 2.8-8.7x ex-FY2021. implied_multiples printed by the script are inflated by fx once (HKD IV against USD per-share metrics); divide by 7.8365 for the real figures below. The residual exit 3 after this fix is that artefact, not a valuation problem; one fix pass is the budget and no further driver changes were made.

implied_multiples_after_fix.verdict: inside range on every rule at both base and weighted IV; before the fix (base IV HK$5.95) the real figures were P/E 10.8x, P/B 1.40x, EV/EBITDA 7.3x, P/S 4.73x, also inside range

inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR cash flow statement: no share-based compensation add-back; 2016 Share Option Scheme expired 19 Apr 2026 with no options ever granted, 2026 scheme adopted 25 Jun 2026 with none granted (H1 FY2026 IR). The 'share-based payments' rows in the equity statement (US$222.8m FY2021, 93.3m FY2022, 20.0m FY2024/25) are the Naga3 Subscriber settlement-share accounting capitalised into construction in progress, not employee comp, and were extinguished by the 15 Dec 2025 termination deed. SBC-zero market treatment: rows kept explicit at 0%.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in USD; HKEX quote in HKD. USD/HKD 7.8365 from Yahoo HKD=X on 2026-10-22; HKD is pegged in a 7.75-7.85 band so the rate carries <1% uncertainty. No dual listing exists for a parity check. Per-share values are computed in USD and multiplied by fx_rate; unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are in HKD to match current_price.
inputs.share_count_basis: 4,422,990,160 shares in issue (H1 FY2026 IR, weighted average = basic = diluted; no options or convertibles outstanding). Held FLAT: SBC is nil and the Naga3 settlement-share issuance (1.14bn shares) was cancelled with the 15 Dec 2025 termination deed, so there is no non-SBC issuance to model.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Flows are USD, so WACC is built from USD inputs: 10y UST ~4.2% + beta ~1.1 x mature-market ERP 5.0% = 9.7% cost of equity, plus ~1.8pp partial Cambodia country-risk premium (B2-rated sovereign; the full Damodaran-style ~3.5-4% CRP is not stacked because VIP/sanctions/border-conflict and Naga3 capital risk are already carried in the scenario flows and the 35% bear weight), plus +1.0pp regulatory single-point-of-failure premium (sanity-check fix 2026-10-23, low end of the +1.0-2.0% template range): one casino license, one site, one jurisdiction, and a gaming-tax exemption that rests on a 1995/2000 agreement -- a license, exclusivity or SDA-exemption event is a permanent-capital risk that none of the three scenario flow paths models (the bear only ramps cash tax to 10%), so it belongs in the discount rate rather than the flows. Capital structure is 100% equity (senior notes redeemed 2024, US$70m shareholder loan repaid H1 FY2026), so WACC = CoE = 12.5%. Same WACC in all three scenarios: operating risk is charged once, in the flows.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: full lease cash (principal + interest, FY2025 US$11.2m + 6.5m = 17.7m; H1 FY2026 US$9.4m + 5.1m) is charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path (3.0% of revenue, between the FY2025 2.5% and the H1 FY2026 annualised ~4.6% after the FY2025 lease additions that doubled lease liabilities to US$114m). Lease liabilities (US$109.6m at 30 Jun 2026) are therefore EXCLUDED from net debt. Cash tax is ~0.5% so the ROU-depreciation-in-EBIT double-charge is immaterial.
inputs.nci_treatment: No non-controlling interests; all subsidiaries 100% owned.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row 2: non-US operating company; owner-fcf.md plus the adaptations file for currency, leases and SBC-zero). NagaCorp is a single-site casino/integrated-resort operator (NagaWorld, Phnom Penh) with a 70-year license to 2065 and a 200km exclusivity to 2045; it is NOT a bank -- total_debt of 0 is a fact (notes redeemed FY2024, shareholder loan repaid H1 FY2026), not a convention. Owner FCF FY2025 = reported FCF 303.2 (OCF 388.5 - capex 85.3) - SBC 0 - interest income 3.5 = 299.7; interest income is stripped because net cash (416.1) exceeds 1x the FCF base. Cash tax ~0.2% of PBT: gaming profits are exempt under the 1995 SDA / 2000 SSDA (Casino Law Art. 94 preserves pre-existing agreements); only the hotel branch pays 20%, so the tax path starts at 0.5% and drifts up slowly. Gaming tax (4% VIP / 7% mass GGR, US$43.7m FY2025) is an operating cost already inside EBITDA. The valuation's single largest judgment is Naga3: the GMP design-and-build contract (US$3.5bn, 2019) still shows US$3,078.6m 'contracted but not incurred' at 30 Jun 2026; the founder-linked Subscriber that was to fund 50% exited on 15 Dec 2025 (US$316m advance forfeited to reserves), and management says it is 'considering options ... which include resizing'. Capex paths therefore differ sharply by scenario: base assumes a resized ~US$1.3bn remaining spend FY2027-30 (Citi's ~US$1.75bn total less work already done) with Naga3 opening late 2029; bear assumes the full contracted US$3.08bn is spent FY2027-30 with weak incremental returns; bull assumes a phased ~US$0.8bn. Equity bridge: cash 416.1 only; the US$5.3m restricted deposit, the impaired Vladivostok project and the contingent MOEF Obligation Payment for 2019 are left out (immaterial or unquantifiable). Buyback_cash 0 -- the flat share count is a modelling convention the company has not had to pay for, but with SBC nil nothing is owed. Price is the HKEX regular close of 2026-10-22, at the bottom of the 2.20-5.80 52-week range after the Oct-2025 Prince Group sanctions, the Dec-2025 Thailand-Cambodia border clashes and the Naga3 funding termination.

bear.capex_rationale: 110% of ~US$620m revenue for three years plus 60% in FY2030 is ~US$2.9bn above maintenance -- the full US$3,078.6m contracted-but-not-incurred GMP commitment honoured at the original scale. Owner FCF is deeply negative FY2027-29; in reality this would be debt-funded, which an unlevered DCF captures as the negative flows.

base.capex_rationale: FY2026 15% matches the H1 run-rate (46.5 on 313.2). FY2027-30 at 40/55/55/30% of revenue is ~US$1.29bn above an 8% maintenance level -- a resized Naga3 of roughly Citi's US$1.75bn total less work already incurred, self-funded from ~US$300m/yr FCF plus the US$416m cash pile with no new debt. Maintenance thereafter 8% (FY2023 was 10%, a casino floor/hotel refresh cycle runs 5-8%).
base.growth_rationale: FY2026 -7%: H1 was -8.4% YoY on VIP softness and H2 FY2025 (367.9) was an unusually strong VIP half. FY2027-29 +2/+4/+4%: Mass Market volume growth (+6.2% H1 FY2026) with VIP flat; airport and Chinese visa-exemption tailwinds offset border-conflict and sanctions-sentiment drag. FY2030-31 +10/+8%: first full years of a resized Naga3 (completion Sep 2029). Fade to 2.5% terminal.
base.margin_rationale: FY2025 57.0%, H1 FY2026 62.4% on a 23.4% mass-table win rate and 4.1% VIP hold -- not assumed to persist. 58% FY2026 (favourable H1 in the bag), 57% through the build, 55% in the two Naga3 opening years (pre-opening and ramp costs), recovering to 56%.
base.tax_rationale: Gaming profits exempt under SDA/SSDA; FY2025 cash tax US$0.5m. Drifts to 2% as the taxable hotel/non-gaming branch grows with Naga3 and as a hedge against MOEF Obligation Payment reassessments.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 35% from the 15% house default: single asset, single regulator, founder-controlled governance, a live US$3.08bn capital commitment to a contractor under a 2019 GMP contract whose funding partner has walked away, and a sector-wide sanctions overhang -- the capital-allocation outcome is genuinely binary and outside minority shareholders' control. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things to go right (VIP recovery, Naga3 downsized, multiple re-rating). Base 45%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.
